cyclic_variants.role: Higher frequency at the same amplitude and sector length
Longer individual load pulses; still only a 36 m sector
Oscillating load about an uphill bias, not just a frequency change
Matched mean-grade envelope without oscillation: isolates the bias effect

notes: All variants start at the common initial state and run the complete course; no sector resets or imposed speed/ratio trajectories.
One road per campaign. Secondary-hill and cyclic screens are separate; final combined course selection remains a later decision.
The 0-degree secondary hill retains all added distances, to distinguish grade effects from simply spending longer on level road.
Feature numerics use the research preset. Strongest selected cases need tighter refinement before manuscript claims.
